description:
**Repro (.pi/tmp/queue-test/probe_queue.exs — test_drain_returns_and_removes / test_order_preservation)**
- Default queue mode is :one_at_a_time.
- Enqueue 3 steering messages.
- Call Agent.drain_steering(loop) → returns 1 message (head only).
- Call again → returns the next 1.

**Why it matters**
- The dequeue overlay (apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex L1218-1226)
  calls Coder.drain_steering once and treats the result as \"all queued
  steering messages\". With default mode, the user sees only 1 item even
  when 5 are queued; the rest stay in the queue.
- The publicly-documented intent of drain_steering / drain_follow_up
  is \"give me all messages so I can show / edit / clear them\", per
  the moduledoc on PendingMessageQueue and the dequeue UX. The :all-vs-
  :one_at_a_time mode is a *loop drainage policy*, not an inspection
  policy.

**Upstream reference (tmp/pi-mono/packages/agent/src/agent.ts L261-275)**
\`\`\`ts
clearSteeringQueue(): void { this.steeringQueue.clear(); }
clearFollowUpQueue(): void { this.followUpQueue.clear(); }
clearAllQueues(): void { ... }
\`\`\`
Upstream's public clear* APIs are unconditional — independent of mode.

**Fix sketch**
Two viable shapes; pick one:
A. Make Agent.drain_steering / drain_follow_up always return all items,
   regardless of mode. Internally the loop's per-turn drain still uses
   PendingMessageQueue.drain/1 with the configured mode, but the public
   API uses a new PendingMessageQueue.drain_all/1.
B. Add a separate Agent.clear_steering / clear_follow_up returning
   all items unconditionally; deprecate drain_* for inspection use.

Option A keeps the existing surface; the TUI overlay just works.
title: [BUG] Agent.drain_steering / drain_follow_up honor :one_at_a_time mode
